title: 第十三章 认完了第十四章 炼药天才
content_zh:
女招待犹豫了一下，深吸一口气，决定按规矩办事，毕竟协会也没有明确规定年龄限制。
“既然公子坚持，那请随我来吧。”她脸上的职业笑容收敛了些，变得公事公办，“需要先登记一下您的信息，并缴纳一百灵石的考核费用。考核失败，费用不退。”
“可以。”楚天舒淡淡点头，随手从储物袋中拿出一百灵石。
女招待接过灵石，心中诧异：储物袋？看走眼了，他应该是某个家族的核心弟子，不然不可能有储物袋。
随后，她不再多言，转身引路：“请跟我来。”
楚天舒跟在女招待身后，无视了身后那两名守卫讥诮的目光，步入大门。
门内是一个极其宽敞的大厅，穹顶高阔，装饰华丽而不失古朴，空气中弥漫着淡淡的、各种药材混合在一起的奇异药香，令人心旷神怡。
大厅内人来人往，大多步履匆匆，神情专注。
女招待将楚天舒引至一个接待柜台前，对里面的一位中年执事说道：“王执事，这位公子要申请一品炼药师考核。”
那位被称为王执事的中年人抬起头，扶了扶鼻梁上的水晶镜片，当看到楚天舒时，脸上同样露出了惊愕和怀疑的神色。他皱了皱眉，看向女招待：“小缦，你确定？这位……小友，年纪是否太小了些？”
女招待无奈地摊了摊手：“这位公子坚持要考核，并已缴纳费用。”
王执事闻言，再次仔细打量了楚天舒一番，见他气度沉静，不似寻常少年那般浮躁，沉吟片刻，还是拿出了登记册：“也罢，规矩并未限定年龄。姓名，年龄，所属势力。”
“楚天舒，十四，楚家。”楚天舒言简意赅。
“楚家？”王执事笔下顿了顿，南元城楚家他自然知道，不过……似乎没出过什么像样的炼药师。他摇了摇头，不再多想，快速登记好，“考核区在二楼左转最里面的房间，李嵩大师今日当值，由他负责你的考核。提醒你一句，李大师脾气不太好，最讨厌哗众取宠之人，你好自为之。”
“多谢。”楚天舒接过一枚代表考核资格的木质号牌，看都没看那王执事和女招待脸上残留的怀疑之色，转身便朝着楼梯走去。
看着他消失在楼梯口的背影，王执事摇了摇头，低声自语：“楚家……楚天舒？没听说过这号人物啊。十四岁的一品炼药师？除非是打娘胎里就开始学炼丹……唉，估计又是哪个心血来潮的世家子，来浪费李大师时间的。”
女招待也撇了撇嘴，显然和王执事想法一致。只有那两名守在门口听到了只言片语的守卫，相视一眼，脸上嘲讽之色更浓，等着看这不知天高地厚的小子如何灰头土脸地被赶出来。
楚天舒踏上二楼，循着指示来到考核房间外。他抬手，轻轻敲响了房门。
“进来。”一个略显沙哑和不耐烦的声音从房内传出。
楚天舒推门而入。房间颇为宽敞，中央摆放着一尊半人高的暗红色药鼎，鼎身上铭刻着简单的火焰纹路，散发着淡淡的温热。药鼎旁站着一位身穿灰色炼药师袍服的老者，头发灰白，面容古板，眉头紧锁，正是当值的考核大师——李嵩。

李嵩看到进来的竟然是一个如此年轻的少年，先是愣了一下，随即脸色迅速沉了下来，语气带着明显的不悦：“小子，你走错地方了吧？这里是炼药师考核区，不是玩耍的地方！”
楚天舒面色不变，将手中的木质号牌递上，平静地说道：“李大师，晚辈楚天舒，申请一品炼药师考核。”
李嵩接过号牌确认了一下，眉头皱得更紧了，几乎能夹死苍蝇。他盯着楚天舒，目光锐利，带着审视和浓浓的不信任：“楚天舒？十四岁？你可知炼药师考核并非儿戏？需要辨识百种基础药材，并能独立成功炼制出一枚品质达到标准的一品丹药！看你年纪，灵力修为恐怕也刚入门不久，如何支撑得了炼丹的消耗？莫要以为看了几本药书，就能来此蒙混过关！”
他的声音严厉，带着一股常年身处高位的威势，若是一般少年，恐怕早已被吓得手足无措。
然而，楚天舒只是微微躬身，语气依旧平稳从容：“晚辈知晓规矩，愿意一试。若失败，心甘情愿承担所有后果，绝无怨言。”
李嵩见他面对自己的威势竟然如此镇定，眼神没有丝毫闪烁，心中倒是闪过一丝惊异。这份心性，倒不像是个纯粹来胡闹的。他冷哼一声，虽然依旧不看好，但规矩就是规矩，既然交了钱，就有资格尝试。
“哼！既然你执意要浪费这一百灵石，老夫便成全你！”李嵩一挥袖袍，指向房间一侧摆放着的大量药材柜，“第一项，辨识药材！随机抽取五十种基础药材，必须在半炷香内准确说出其名称、药性、以及常见用途！错漏超过五种，即为失败！”
“是。”楚天舒走到药材柜前，目光扫过那密密麻麻、形态各异的数百种药材，眼神平静无波。
李嵩随手在柜子上拍了几下，机关转动，五十个装着不同药材的小格子弹了出来。
李嵩道：“考核，正式开始！”
房间内，只剩下计时沙漏细沙流动的簌簌声，以及李嵩那带着审视和怀疑的锐利目光。
一秒。
两秒。
三秒。
楚天舒站在药材柜前，目光平静地扫过那五十种药材，身形稳如磐石，毫无动作。
……
五秒。
六秒。
七秒。
七秒过后，眼见楚天舒依旧只是目光游离地看着那些药材，甚至还有闲暇打量了一下房间四周，完全没有要动手拿起任何一株药材仔细辨认的意思，李嵩胸中的火气“噌”地一下就冒了上来。

他为了冲击三品炼药师，连日来废寝忘食地翻看典籍、尝试炼丹，耗费了无数心力，熬得头发都又白了几根，最是见不得别人浪费他宝贵的时间，尤其是这种在他看来纯属胡闹的行为！
“你这小辈！”李嵩猛地一拍身旁的桌子，发出“砰”的一声巨响，须发皆张，怒喝道：“拿我寻开心是吧？半天都不见你动一下，搁这干瞪眼呢！辨认草药，可观其形色，可闻其气味，甚至可碾碎细察！你这是在做什么？若是自知不行，现在退出还来得及，莫要在此消遣老夫！”
他气得胸口起伏，觉得眼前这少年简直不可理喻。
然而，面对李嵩的雷霆之怒，楚天舒只是缓缓转过头，脸上依旧是一片令人恼火的平静，他淡淡开口：“我已经认完了。”

content_en:
The waitress hesitated, took a deep breath, and decided to follow the rules. After all, the association did not clearly stipulate an age limit.
"Since the young master insists, please come with me." The professional smile on her face softened and became business-like. "You need to register your information first and pay the assessment fee of one hundred spirit stones. If you fail the assessment, the fee will not be refunded."
"Okay." Chu Tianshu nodded lightly and took out a hundred spiritual stones from the storage bag.
The waitress took the spirit stone and was surprised: storage bag? I misjudged him. He should be a core disciple of a certain family, otherwise there would be no storage bag.
Then, she said no more, turned around and led the way: "Please follow me."
Chu Tianshu followed the waitress, ignoring the mocking glances of the two guards behind him, and stepped into the door.
Inside the door is an extremely spacious hall with a high dome and gorgeous yet simple decoration. The air is filled with a faint and strange fragrance of various medicinal materials, which is refreshing and refreshing.
People were coming and going in the hall, most of them walking in a hurry and looking attentive.
The waitress led Chu Tianshu to a reception counter and said to a middle-aged deacon inside: "Deacon Wang, this young man wants to apply for the first-grade alchemist examination."
The middle-aged man known as Deacon Wang raised his head and adjusted the crystal lens on the bridge of his nose. When he saw Chu Tianshu, he also had a look of surprise and suspicion on his face. He frowned and looked at the waitress: "Xiaoman, are you sure? Is this... little friend too young?"
The waitress spread her hands helplessly: "This young man insists on taking the assessment and has paid the fee."
Upon hearing this, Deacon Wang looked at Chu Tianshu carefully again and saw that he had a calm demeanor, not as impetuous as ordinary young people. He pondered for a moment and took out the registration book: "Forget it, the rules do not limit the age. Name, age, and power."
"Chu Tianshu, fourteen, Chu family." Chu Tianshu spoke concisely and concisely.
"Chu family?" Deacon Wang paused in his writing. He naturally knew about the Chu family in Nanyuan City, but...it seemed that they didn't have any decent alchemists. He shook his head, no longer thought about it, and quickly registered, "The assessment area is in the innermost room on the left on the second floor. Master Li Song is on duty today, and he will be responsible for your assessment. Let me remind you that Master Li has a bad temper and hates people who flatter others the most. You should take care of yourself."
"Thank you." Chu Tianshu took a wooden number plate that represented the qualifications for assessment. Without even looking at the doubts remaining on the faces of Deacon Wang and the waitress, he turned and walked towards the stairs.
Seeing his back disappearing at the top of the stairs, Deacon Wang shook his head and whispered to himself: "Chu family...Chu Tianshu? Never heard of this person. A fourteen-year-old first-grade alchemist? Unless he started learning alchemy right from his mother's womb... Sigh, it's probably some family member who came to waste Master Li's time on a whim."
The waitress also curled her lips, obviously having the same idea as Deacon Wang. Only the two guards who were guarding the door heard a few words. They looked at each other with more mocking expressions on their faces, waiting to see how this ignorant boy would be driven out in disgrace.
Chu Tianshu stepped onto the second floor and followed the instructions to the outside of the assessment room. He raised his hand and knocked gently on the door.
"Come in." A slightly hoarse and impatient voice came from the room.
Chu Tianshu pushed the door open and entered. The room is quite spacious, with a dark red medicinal cauldron half a man's height placed in the center. The cauldron is engraved with simple flame patterns and exudes a faint warmth. Standing next to the medicine cauldron was an old man wearing a gray alchemist's robe. He had gray hair, a stern face, and a frown. He was the assessment master on duty—Li Song.
Li Song saw such a young boy coming in. He was stunned for a moment, and then his face quickly darkened, with obvious displeasure in his tone: "Boy, are you in the wrong place? This is the alchemist assessment area, not a place to play.! "
Chu Tianshu's expression remained unchanged, he handed over the wooden number plate in his hand, and said calmly: "Master Li, junior Chu Tianshu, applies for the first-grade alchemist examination. "
Li Song took the number plate and confirmed it, his brows furrowed even more tightly, almost enough to kill a fly. He stared at Chu Tianshu with sharp eyes, full of scrutiny and deep distrust: "Chu Tianshu? Fourteen years old? Did you know that the alchemist exam is no child’s play? You need to identify hundreds of basic medicinal materials and be able to independently and successfully refine a first-grade elixir that meets the standard! Judging from your age, you may have just started cultivating spiritual power. How can you support the consumption of alchemy? Don’t think that you can get away with it just by reading a few medicine books! "
His voice was stern, carrying the power of someone who had been in a high position all year round. If he were an ordinary young man, he would have been frightened to a loss.
However, Chu Tianshu just bowed slightly and his tone remained calm and calm: "Junior knows the rules and is willing to give it a try. If you fail, you will be willing to bear all the consequences without any complaints. "
Li Song saw that he was so calm in the face of his power, his eyes did not flicker at all, but a hint of surprise flashed in his heart. This kind of mentality is not like someone who is just messing around. He snorted coldly. Although he was still not optimistic, the rules were the rules. Since he paid the money, he was qualified to try.
"Hmph! Since you insist on wasting these one hundred spirit stones, I will help you! "Li Song waved his sleeves and pointed to the large number of medicinal cabinets placed on one side of the room, "The first item is to identify the medicinal materials! Fifty basic medicinal materials are randomly selected, and their names, medicinal properties, and common uses must be accurately stated within half a stick of incense! If there are more than five errors or omissions, it is considered a failure! "
"yes. "Chu Tianshu walked to the medicine cabinet and glanced at the densely packed hundreds of medicinal materials of different shapes with calm eyes.
Li Song casually tapped the cabinet a few times, the mechanism turned, and fifty small compartments containing different medicinal materials popped out.
Li Song said: "The assessment has officially begun! "
In the room, the only sounds left were the rustling sound of the sand flowing through the hourglass, and Li Song's sharp gaze with scrutiny and suspicion.
One second.
Two seconds.
Three seconds.
Chu Tianshu stood in front of the medicine cabinet, his eyes calmly scanning the fifty kinds of medicines, his body as steady as a rock and motionless.
…
Five seconds.
Six seconds.
Seven seconds.
Seven seconds later, when he saw that Chu Tianshu was still looking at the medicinal materials with wandering eyes, and even had time to look around the room, with no intention of picking up any medicinal materials and carefully identifying them, the anger in Li Song's chest suddenly came up.
In order to become a third-level alchemist, he had been reading classics and trying to make elixirs for days without sleep and food. He spent countless efforts and made his hair turn gray. The most important thing was that he couldn't see others wasting his precious time, especially this kind of behavior that he considered to be pure nonsense!
"You junior! "Li Song slammed the table next to him, making a loud "bang" sound, his beard and hair stood out, and he shouted angrily: "Are you having fun with me? I haven't seen you move for a long time, and you are just staring at me! To identify herbs, you can look at their shape, smell, and even crush them! What are you doing? If you know you can't do it, it's still too late to quit now, don't amuse me here! "
His chest heaved with anger, feeling that the young man in front of him was simply unreasonable.
However, facing Li Song's thunderous wrath, Chu Tianshu just slowly turned his head, his face was still irritatingly calm, and he said calmly: "I have already acknowledged it. "
